common.ecosystem_desc: The Victoria Project ecosystem brings together a set of innovative solutions focused on artificial intelligence and automation.
common.ecosystem_intro: At the centre, my Victoria project. Around it, the projects that orbit its ecosystem — each with its own logic: the infrastructure, an AI building block or a concrete application.
common.ecosystem_hint: Hover or click a project to discover its role in the ecosystem.

ecosystem.core_desc: Victoria is the heart of the ecosystem: a local, modular AI assistant. The other projects extend that approach — each explores a building block, an application or the infrastructure behind it.

project-13.desc: Loom automates data and ML pipelines: the engineering logic behind the ecosystem's models.

project-6.desc: Img Classifier explores convolutional neural networks: a vision capability and an example of a reusable AI model.

project-1779285718375.desc: Yomu is a finished product built with the same AI approach: a light-novel translator putting the ecosystem's building blocks into practice.

home.subtitle: Computer Science & Management Student (BUT & L3 MTS)
home.description: I am passionate about AI, web development and emerging technologies. Every day, I learn and explore new ideas to become a teacher-researcher.

about.title:
Understand the code.
Decrypt the world.
about.subtitle: I build bridges between algorithms and human sciences. Future teacher-researcher with an international vocation.

vision.title: My Vision
vision.p1: Computer science is often perceived as cold and binary. For me, it is a lens to observe the complexity of the world.
vision.p2: I believe in an interdisciplinary approach where sociology enlightens the use of algorithms and where geopolitics explains data flows.

parcours.title: My Journey
parcours.p1: Currently in my 3rd year of computer science at the IUT of Montpellier and in a double degree L3 MTS at IAE Montpellier, I specialize in algorithms and complex systems.
parcours.p2: My goal is to pursue a Master's in Bioinformatics, where I will combine computer science and life sciences to analyze biological data.
parcours.p3: In parallel, I am developing a personal AI to explore Machine Learning and its practical applications.

international.title: International Ambition
international.description: Learning languages to teach across the world. Intercultural exchange is the engine of my research.

about.quote: Humanity uses technology like a child playing with a candle. The game is to know when to pull your hand back.

purposes.personnel_desc: This project was carried out in my free time out of pure passion. It allows me to explore new technologies and push my limits outside the school framework.

project-1.description: CodeTonFutur is a computer science popularization site.
project-1.longDescription: This project is a complete web application demonstrating the use of modern technologies like Vue.js, TypeScript, and Vite. The application offers a smooth and efficient user experience.

features.2: Structured learning paths organized by difficulty level

project-2.description: Platform dedicated to Capture The Flag (CTF) challenges in cybersecurity.
project-2.longDescription: Break The Code is an interactive platform for Capture The Flag (CTF) challenges in cybersecurity, developed as part of an associative project at the IUT.

features.1: "Rainbow Jumper" game to obtain the flag

project-2.context: Academic project carried out in a group of 4 people as part of the SAÉ (Learning and Assessment Situation) of the Computer Science BUT. The goal was to create an educational tool for first-year students.
project-2.duration: 4 intensive months (about 150 hours of collective work, including 50 personal hours).
project-2.personalContribution: My major contribution was adapting the Flask API in compliance with BUT standards and setting up the Docker infrastructure. I also created two complex challenges: an SSH injection flaw and a 'Rainbow Jumper' game hiding a flag within its jump mechanics.

project-3.description: Web application for a business simulation video game.
project-3.longDescription: Web application for a video game that allows users to compete in a business simulation. Players manage resources, make strategic decisions, and compete to dominate the virtual market.

features.4: Writing Balance Sheets, Profit and Loss accounts

project-3.context: Completed during the SAÉ of the 3rd semester of the Computer Science BUT. This group project (5 people) aimed to simulate the internal workings of a company and its accounting management through a web interface.
project-3.duration: One academic semester (~2000 hours of group work, 500 personal hours).
project-3.personalContribution: I took charge of the database modeling and the implementation of the business logic in Symfony. I developed the algorithms for the automatic calculation of financial statements and income statements, ensuring the consistency of the game's economic data.

project-4.description: Statistical data analysis tools for satellite collision warnings.
project-4.longDescription: Star Guardian is software designed to perform advanced statistical analysis on collision alerts involving satellites in orbit.

features.2: Automatic generation of security reports in Excel format

project-4.context: Internship carried out at the University Space Center of Montpellier (CSUM). The goal was to address a real space traffic management problem for the center's operator.
project-4.personalContribution: I designed and developed the entire analysis engine in Python with Pandas. I built the user interface with Tkinter and handled structured export to Excel. I also documented the tool to ensure its maintenance by the CSUM teams.

project-5.description: Adaptation of the board game Trains into a Java video game.
project-5.longDescription: Project consisting of recreating the Japanese board game Trains in Java, with a JavaFX graphical interface and a TDD approach.
project-5.context: Second-year academic project (pair) focused on Software Quality and Test-Driven Development (TDD). The emphasis was on code robustness rather than graphic aesthetics.
project-5.duration: 4 months (about 100 hours of work, including 60 personal hours).
project-5.personalContribution: I was responsible for setting up the unit test suite (JUnit) and implementing the business logic. I worked particularly on the pathfinding algorithm (Dijkstra) to validate connectivity between cities on the game board.

project-6.longDescription: Creation of an AI capable of classifying images by category. Use of PyTorch and convolutional networks.
project-6.context: Personal self-training project in Deep Learning. I wanted to step outside the academic framework to explore cutting-edge artificial intelligence technologies (PyTorch).
project-6.duration: One year of sporadic learning and experimentation (~150 cumulative hours).
project-6.personalContribution: Sole developer. I collected and labeled the dataset, designed the CNN architecture (convolution, pooling, dropout layers) and optimized the hyperparameters to reach 98% accuracy. I also created a dashboard to visualize loss and accuracy during training.

project-7.description: Modular desktop assistant with local AI.
project-7.longDescription: Victoria is a desktop application using a local artificial intelligence (Ollama), extensible via plugins.
project-7.context: Personal 'showcase' project aiming to demonstrate my ability to design complex modular systems and integrate generative AI technologies (LLM/RAG).
project-7.duration: Flagship project under development (~200 hours invested).
project-7.personalContribution: Lead designer. I developed a dynamic plugin loading system in Python and implemented a vector database (ChromaDB) to give the AI a 'long-term memory' of my local documents.

project-8.longDescription: Web application to learn 10 words per day via quizzes and review sheets.
project-8.context: Personal project born from my own difficulty in staying consistent in language learning (Mandarin, Japanese). I wanted to create a tool that fits perfectly into a daily routine without being time-consuming.
project-8.duration: Project started in September 2025, about 80 hours of active development.
project-8.personalContribution: Sole full-stack developer. I used Symfony for user and content management, and integrated Firebase to ensure instant synchronization of progress across different devices. I also designed the word selection algorithm based on the user's past mistakes.

project-10.description: Community site for rating video games, anime, and manga.
project-10.longDescription: Anakomi is a platform allowing users to rate and comment on their favorite works while consulting community rankings.
project-10.context: Personal project carried out to put into practice my skills in managing complex relational databases and in Flask development.
project-10.duration: Project completed over one intensive month (~50 hours).
project-10.personalContribution: Designer and developer. I set up the MySQL database schema handling thousands of references and implemented the weighted average calculation system for community rankings.

project-11.description: National web development challenge in teams over an entire night.
project-11.longDescription: Project carried out as part of Nuit de l'Info. The challenge was to collaborate in teams to develop a functional web application from sunset to sunrise.

features.2: Respect for a theme and technical constraints

project-11.context: National inter-school competition. It is a test of endurance and extreme collaboration under high time pressure.
project-11.personalContribution: I handled the organization of the Vue.js code, the integration of graphic assets, and ensured liaison with the backend developer for real-time API consumption. I also managed versioning via Git to avoid any conflict during the night.

project-12.description: CHIRAL is an educational video game about the dangers of mirror life creation.
project-12.longDescription: CHIRAL sensitizes players to the dangers of creating mirror life. The game features a mirror bacterium that spreads rapidly, endangering the ecological balance.
project-12.context: Personal project combining my passion for biology (Bioinformatics) and video game development. The goal is to raise public awareness of complex scientific concepts through play.
project-12.duration: Project ongoing since January 2026 (~40 hours invested).
project-12.personalContribution: Developer and writer. I created the game mechanics in pure JavaScript and wrote all the educational dialogues. I also designed the simulation system for the spread of the mirror bacterium.

project-13.description: Data processing pipeline for machine learning.
project-13.longDescription: Loom is a project aimed at automating the data workflow for AI models, from collection to deployment.

features.1: Scalable preprocessing pipeline for massive datasets
features.2: Automatic model deployment via Flask/Docker API

project-13.context: Personal project born from the need to industrialize my own AI experiments. I wanted to create a reusable tool for all my future research projects.
project-13.duration: Ongoing research and development project (~60 hours).
project-13.personalContribution: System architect. I developed the core of the pipeline in Python, allowing flexible configuration through YAML files. I also integrated monitoring tools to track model performance in production.

project-14.description: Big Data analysis platform for genomics.
project-14.longDescription: Bio-Data Analyzer is a solution for massive DNA sequence analysis using distributed architectures (Spark/Hadoop). The project integrates Deep Learning models for protein structure prediction and large-scale biological data clustering.

features.0: Distributed processing of FASTQ/BAM files via Spark
features.1: Sequence classification by deep neural networks
features.2: Interactive visualization of multidimensional data clusters

project-15.description: Cloud monitoring and secure orchestration system.
project-15.longDescription: Cloud Sentinel is a complete infrastructure for monitoring cloud services using Kubernetes and Terraform. The project includes an automated CI/CD chain, an AI-based intrusion detection system, and a steering interface for incident management.

features.1: Automated deployment (CI/CD) with GitHub Actions and Terraform
features.2: Real-time monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana

yomu.description: AI light novel PDF translator (v2 of Projekt Bersetzung).
yomu.longDescription:
Direct evolution of v1 with a clear architectural shift. Key improvements:
- Move to a Flask backend + React frontend
- Modernized interface and clearer user flow
- Dropped PyInstaller in favor of service-based launch
- Stronger AI engine with quality/performance modes
- Async processing and improved layout preservation
- Added bilingual reading room and EPUB export
yomu.context: Personal project to speed up translation and reading of light novels.
yomu.personalContribution: End-to-end development of the Flask backend and React UI, plus AI model integration and processing pipeline.

projekt-bersetzung.description: PDF novel translation software (v1 of Yomu).
projekt-bersetzung.longDescription: Initial project focused on translating PDF novels into French with a simple workflow. This v1 laid the functional foundation that evolved into Yomu (v2).
projekt-bersetzung.context: Personal project born from the need to read untranslated light novels.
projekt-bersetzung.personalContribution: Full design and implementation: Tkinter UI, PDF processing, and translated file generation.

features.0: Simple UI with drag-and-drop PDF and target language selection
features.1: Generate a translated PDF while preserving the layout

features.0: Modern and responsive interface with Vue.js

victoria.description_text: Victoria is a desktop application using a local artificial intelligence, which aims to be as modular and customizable as possible. The main objective is to allow users to add plugins to extend its functionality in a simple and efficient way. Victoria is a versatile platform designed to be shared, adapted to various needs and easily extensible thanks to its modular architecture.
victoria.feature_customtkinter: Modern user interface with CustomTkinter for a smooth experience.
victoria.feature_watchdog: Real-time monitoring of plugin folders with Watchdog.
victoria.tech_description: This project implements Python for the logic, PyTorch for the AI, and CustomTkinter for the interface. Watchdog allows automatic file monitoring.
